author: blu
body: Unified network configuration state. Holds the results of DHCP lease acquisition, DNS resolver setup, and NTP time sync. Provides the single record that the rest of the OS consults for "how do I reach the network."

author: blu
body: A LEASE OF ZERO IS NOT DUE. Nothing under codex-vm's NAT expires and a static configuration has no lease at all, so a due-check that read zero as "elapsed" would renew on every pass forever.
